observations: Photo shows a used internal combustion engine assembly on the floor (long block with intake/exhaust manifolds and hoses).
There is a label/sticker on the top cover area, but the text/model is not clearly readable in this image.
Visible grime/dust and signs of prior use; no clear evidence of recent cleaning.
No close-up of engine serial/model plate, no ports/cylinder head close-up, and no running/test footage.

claims.claim: Direct America very neet and tested ok, with 3 month guarantee
claims.evidence: No photo evidence of testing (no running video, no diagnostic screen, no test report). Guarantee terms not shown.

risks.risk: Engine model/compatibility is unclear; wrong engine for the buyer’s vehicle can make it unsellable or unusable.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine identification plate/serial number and the full readable label on the top cover (straight-on, high resolution).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unknown used engine (worst-case: may not match required vehicle/fitment).

risks.risk: Condition may be poor internally (low compression, worn bearings, head gasket issues) even if it looks intact externally.
risks.proof: Compression test results (video/photo of gauge readings) or a short running video showing stable idle and no smoke/knocking.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven tested (worst-case: treat as not working/needs overhaul).

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (alternator, starter, sensors, turbo/hoses) or damaged components not visible in this single wide shot.
risks.proof: A full parts inventory photo: both sides of the engine, front/back, and close-ups of key components (starter, alternator mounts, sensors, wiring connectors, intake/exhaust connections).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst-case: assume missing or damaged accessories).

risks.risk: Potential fluid leaks or cracked housings (coolant/oil) that are not obvious from this angle.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all seams and joints plus a wipe-and-check photo after cleaning (or a short leak test video).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as may leak (worst-case: assume leaks/needs reseal).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine ID/serial/model plate (readable) and the top label text.
Short running video (cold start if possible) showing stable idle and no abnormal smoke/knocking.
Compression test readings (all cylinders) or diagnostic scan results.
Photos of both sides and all connectors/ports, plus a list of included accessories (starter/alternator/sensors/ECU if any).
response.reason: From the photo, this is an unknown used engine and the seller’s “tested ok” and “3 month guarantee” cannot be verified remotely. Without readable model/ID and proof of testing/condition, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
